acceptanceCriteria: A test drafts citations for a diff with an in-path or requirement-defining span available and shows the drafted row is anchored (no CEM-V1-081 WARN from dogfood-check).
When no anchored span exists, the drafted row records why it fell back.
body: Residual from the dogfood-flow-1021t lane (PR #1513). Citation rows drafted by propose-citations pick spans that dogfood-check later reports with the CEM-V1-081 tier-below-anchored advisory WARN, so every lane hand-edits the plan or carries the warnings. Expected: the drafter prefers a span that contains the hunk path, or one that defines a requirement the hunk adds, before falling back to a lower-tier span. Related checker-side suspicion: V1-2343 (warnings on new files cited by a direct dependency). Suspected defect: reproduced on one lane only.
